name: Makino Suguru
source:
The corporate director of Okoshi Pharmaceutical. He is Ai's father, making him both [url=/c73542]Kenji Osawa[/url]'s boss and father-in-law. His ruthless and greedy behavior has him control Osawa's actions as he aims to quickly profit from their antiviral research.

[spoiler]He engaged in illegal human testing with the antiviral in South Africa to advance the drug's development as quickly as possible. Despite his cold demeanor, he is a frequent customer at a local cat cafe.[/spoiler]
